title: Formatting imported data
body:
Hi, I'm a complete newbie to Algolia but loving what I see so far.  I have a simple faceted search working for 4000 products but I have an issue where the price is being displayed in alphabetical order, not numerical.  I understand this is because the price index is a string and not an integer.

I've used the instructions here: https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/indexing/import-synchronize-data/php to import my data but am really struggling on how to tell the API to import my price field as an integer.

Any help would be much appreciated.  Thanks.

comments.body: I guess you fixed this @spindriftwebs, maybe you can add a small comment on how you fixed it for future reference?
